caption: The drawing depicts a hand fan with a semicircular shape. The fan has a brown base and ribs that extend outward, supporting the main section, which is decorated with a floral pattern. The flowers on the fan are primarily colored in pink, red, and blue, and are interspersed with green leaves. The floral design appears intricate, with multiple large blossoms overlapping slightly. The background of the image is plain and uncolored, drawing attention solely to the multicolored fan at the center of the composition, placed against a cream or light beige backdrop. The fan is centered on the page with ample empty space surrounding it.
title: Fan
